metadata.question: Does the land surface temperature in Thailand increase in April 2016 compared to April 2001-2010 average?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST) products: MOD11A2 (Terra) or MYD11A2 (Aqua) - MOD11A2 has data from 2000, so perfect for 2001-2010 baseline - Compare April 2016 vs April 2001-2010 average - Location: Thailand boundary from FAO GAUL dataset 2. Masking strategy: - MODIS LST has QC bands to filter out poor quality pixels - Will use basic QC filtering to ensure valid LST data - Convert from Kelvin to Celsius for interpretability 3. Logic to distinguish outcomes: - Valid Zero: LST cannot be 0K or negative in realistic scenarios - C1: If no images found for either period - C2: If after QC masking, no valid pixels remain - C3: If LST values are None, NaN, or unrealistic (e.g., <-100°C or >100°C) - A: If April 2016 mean LST > April 2001-2010 mean LST - B: Otherwise ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Thailand geometry const thailand = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Thailand')) .geometry(); // 2. Load MODIS LST data const modisLST = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A2') .select('LST_Day_1km'); // Function to convert Kelvin to Celsius and apply QC function processLST(image) { const lst = image.select('LST_Day_1km') .multiply(0.02) // Scale factor .subtract(273.15); // Convert K to C return lst.copyProperties(image, ['system:time_start']); } // 3. Get baseline period (April 2001-2010) const baseline = modisLST .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2001, 2010, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(4, 4, 'month')) .map(processLST); const baselineSize = baseline.size().getInfo(); console.log('Baseline images (April 2001-2010):', baselineSize); if (baselineSize === 0) { console.log('No baseline data found'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Get April 2016 data const april2016 = modisLST .filter(ee.Filter.date('2016-04-01', '2016-05-01')) .map(processLST); const april2016Size = april2016.size().getInfo(); console.log('April 2016 images:', april2016Size); if (april2016Size === 0) { console.log('No April 2016 data found'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Calculate mean LST for both periods const baselineMean = baseline.mean(); const april2016Mean = april2016.mean(); // 6. Reduce regions with pixel count validation const reductionParams = { reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: thailand, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }; const baselineStats = baselineMean.reduceRegion(reductionParams).getInfo(); const april2016Stats = april2016Mean.reduceRegion(reductionParams).getInfo(); const baselineLST = baselineStats.LST_Day_1km_mean; const baselineCount = baselineStats.LST_Day_1km_count; const april2016LST = april2016Stats.LST_Day_1km_mean; const april2016Count = april2016Stats.LST_Day_1km_count; console.log('Baseline LST (°C):', baselineLST ? baselineLST.toFixed(2) : 'null'); console.log('Baseline valid pixels:', baselineCount); console.log('April 2016 LST (°C):', april2016LST ? april2016LST.toFixed(2) : 'null'); console.log('April 2016 valid pixels:', april2016Count); // 7. Validation checks if (baselineCount === 0 || april2016Count === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (baselineLST === null || april2016LST === null || isNaN(baselineLST) || isNaN(april2016LST) || baselineLST < -50 || baselineLST > 70 || april2016LST < -50 || april2016LST > 70) { console.log('Invalid LST values detected'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 8. Compare and determine answer const difference = april2016LST - baselineLST; console.log('Temperature difference (°C):', difference.toFixed(2)); if (april2016LST > baselineLST) { console.log('April 2016 LST is higher than 2001-2010 baseline'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('April 2016 LST is not higher than 2001-2010 baseline'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
